title: Shape tween
description: Shape tween between two keyframes: morphs one shape into another over time. Uses shape blend (distributive/angular). Visual: green band in timeline (vs blue for motion). Property inspector ease and blend mode. Interpolate path points between start/end keyframes. See docs/02-timeline-and-animation.md (Shape tween). Depends on motion-tween-mvp, draw-tools-integration.
